en.headline: Wong Tai Sin temple opens Mid-Autumn lantern evenings from today
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen's Pou Chai Heung Kong lantern programme runs from 17 September as part of the organisation's 105th anniversary and National Day events.
body: Sik Sik Yuen said its Pou Chai Heung Kong Mid-Autumn lantern evenings open at Wong Tai Sin Temple from Thursday, 17 September, running into early October as part of the organisation's 105th anniversary and National Day commemorations.

The temple's supervisor, Li Yiu-fai, wrote that the grounds will display festival lanterns and a 105th anniversary timeline of 105 goat-shaped lamps marking the organisation's history. Workshops and lantern-riddle sessions are planned on Saturdays, Sundays and specified festival days, with night-glow dragon performances on some evenings.

The official events listing names the programme National Day 77th anniversary and Sik Sik Yuen 105th anniversary — Pou Chai Heung Kong Mid-Autumn lantern evenings, dated 17 September to 6 October, alongside a separate Wong Tai Sin birthday-month programme over the same span. Admission details and nightly closing times should be checked against notices at the temple.
Wong Tai Sin Temple is in Wong Tai Sin, Kowloon, a short walk from Wong Tai Sin MTR station. Mid-Autumn Day this year falls on 25 September.

zh.headline: 嗇色園黃大仙祠中秋綵燈晚會今起舉行
zh.dek: 「普濟香江中秋綵燈晚會」周四起在黃大仙祠展開，屬嗇色園105周年及國慶系列活動，展出花燈及105盎山羊造型紀慶燈。
body: 嗇色園公布，「國慶77周年暨嗇色園105周年紀慶—普濟香江中秋綵燈晚會」由9月17日星期四起在黃大仙祠舉行，活動期跨越10月上旬。
黃大仙祠監院李耀輝撰文表示，祠內將展出多款中秋花燈，並特設「105紀慶年表燈」，以105盎山羊造型燈飾呈現嗇色園歷史。星期六、日及迎月、追月等指定日子會設工作坊及遊園猜燈謎，部分晚上亦有夜光龍表演。
嗇色園活動一覽將綵燈晚會日期列為9月17日至10月6日，同期另有赤松黃大仙寶誕月慶典。入場安排及每晚關園時間以祠內及園方當日公布為準。
黃大仙祠位於九龍黃大仙，港鐵黃大仙站步行可達。今年中秋正日為9月25日。
